title: Open extension comparison from uniqueness of left adjoints
statement: Given locally closed extension data E, normalized geometry G and a field k, there exists ScalarSixOpenComparison E G k. Its ordinary open extension comparison has the prescribed inverse-image mate. Uses [def-sfb-scalar-six-coefficient-interfaces].

proof.text: Conjugate the inverse-image comparison along the actual internal and section open-extension adjunctions. The conjugate is invertible, and the mate bijection gives precisely the requested equation.

proof_origin.place: Normalized coefficient and geometric comparisons; adjunction mate calculation and open/closed assembly
